static_checks.message: Must define machine and stream contracts

evals.prompt: Design a new fieldkit sf renewals command before we implement it
evals.expected_behavior: Produces a fieldkit-specific command contract before code
assertions: Inspects the live Click tree and canonical CLI architecture and exit-code docs
Defines command tree, arguments, options, help, stdout, stderr, JSON, and 0/1/2/3 failures
Provides grep-checkable acceptance and tests for observable plumbing

evals.prompt: Add --account to fieldkit pipeline export and make it work in human and JSON modes
evals.expected_behavior: Specifies the material option change end to end
assertions: Traces --account from Click parsing through domain filtering to observable human and JSON output
Defines unknown-account and accepted-but-ignored regression tests
Covers compatibility, generated docs, and non-interactive behavior

evals.prompt: Design a fieldkit delete command that automation can run safely
evals.expected_behavior: Defines preview and explicit mutation safety
assertions: Defines default preview or dry-run behavior and explicit confirmation semantics
Specifies TTY and non-interactive behavior without putting secrets in argv
Defines idempotence, partial failures, stdout/stderr, JSON, and canonical exits

evals.prompt: Refactor the internal Salesforce response parser without changing CLI behavior
evals.expected_behavior: Does not route to create-cli for an ordinary domain refactor
assertions: Does not require a new CLI interface spec solely because the parser is command-reachable
